title: Father and Baby Portrait, 1920s Sepia Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: An early 20th-century candid outdoor portrait showing a father seated on a chair on a lawn, tenderly holding a baby on his knee. The father is dressed in classic 1910s-1920s menswear, featuring a straw boater hat, a dark suit jacket, and a bow tie. The baby is wearing a light-colored bonnet and dress. In the background, a garden pathway, lush foliage, and a trellis fence are visible.
